mentions.name: Gipfelbuch
mentions.description: A tiny adventure journal for the outdoors. Users upload a GPX file to see the route, map, and key stats, and can store every hike, bike ride, walk, or trek in one place. It is designed as a personal notebook for families rather than a leaderboard and is in early-stage development, with a demo mode (now including a sample GPX file) and a PWA.
mentions.audience: Personal notebook for families rather than a leaderboard; built to keep the stories of the author's own kids' outdoor adventures.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A tiny adventure journal for the outdoors: https://gipfelbuch.org/

* Upload a GPX file -> see the route, map and key stats.

* Store every hike, bike ride, walk, or trek in one place.

* Think of it as a “personal notebook” for families, not a leaderboard.
